SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT PLANT, PONO, POSEQ FROM ERPDB.KEPPO WHERE IFFLAG = '0'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'SNTD' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, PLANT AS PLANT, PONO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, POSEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, STATUS AS STATUS, ITEMNO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, POGBN AS REF_IF_NO, POACT AS ACCOUNT_TYPE, PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, QTY AS ITEM_QTY, AMT AS ITEM_AMT, ADDDTE AS ADD_DATE, RDDATE AS RD_DATE, LOCA AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, PURID AS PURCHASER_USER_ID, REQNME AS REQ_USER_NAME, REQDPT AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME, REQTEL AS REQ_USER_TEL, IFDATE AS LOAD_DATE, IFTIME AS LOAD_TIME, REMARK AS REMARK FROM ERPDB.KEPPO WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND PONO = '$G_RS.PONO$' AND POSEQ = '$G_RS.POSEQ$' AND IFFLAG = '0' ORDER BY PLANT, PONO, POSEQ
UPDATE ERPDB.KEPPO SET IFFLAG = '1' WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND PONO = '$G_RS.PONO$' AND POSEQ = '$G_RS.POSEQ$' AND IFFLAG = '0'
UPDATE ERPDB.KEPPO SET IFFLAG = '0' WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND PONO = '$G_RS.PONO$' AND POSEQ = '$G_RS.POSEQ$' AND IFFLAG = '0'
